findings.issue: PostgreSQL 18 UUID constraint failure: appointments.doctor_user_id is strict uuid fk to users.id. Incoming 'doc-1' mock string threw 22P02 invalid input syntax for type uuid and crashed booking flow.
findings.resolution: Hardened doctorUserId resolution: validates UUID format and checks against active clinic doctors in users table. Graceful fallback to first active doctor if omitted/invalid. Real doctor UUID properly persisted.

findings.issue: Potemkin doctor list: hardcoded array of doc-1..doc-4 with mock Russian names not matching actual clinic staff in PostgreSQL 18 database.
findings.resolution: Replaced with dynamic doctor extraction from Fastify /api/telegram/webapp/slots response. Real doctors with their actual UUIDs, full names, and specialties are rendered.

findings.issue: Apple HIG Natural Thumb Zone violation: calendar date chips had touch target < 44px (min-h-[40px]), and booking CTA button scrolled out of view at the bottom requiring long scroll on mobile.
findings.resolution: Upgraded calendar date chips to min-h-[52px] with >= 44x44px touch targets. Encapsulated primary booking CTA inside .tg-floating-bottom-bar (sticky bottom: 0, backdrop-filter: blur(20px), safe-area padding).
